quality_guards: Toy risk depends on design, materials, small parts, age grading, instructions, connected features and foreseeable misuse.
Toy-safety evidence is product-, age-, design-, market- and use-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Furniture fire risk depends on materials, construction, ignition source, product condition, setting and user behaviour.
Furniture evidence is product-, material-, test-, premises- and use-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire probability.
Product risk depends on design, conformity, condition, installation, maintenance, user group and foreseeable misuse.
General product-safety evidence is product-, supplier-, market-, condition- and user-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Firework risk depends on category, condition, space, weather, ignition, audience distance, storage and supervision.
Consumer-firework evidence is product-, location-, timing-, operator- and audience-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Measles risk depends on immunity, exposure, setting, contact intensity, timing and vulnerability to complications.
Measles surveillance evidence is case-, region-, age-, reporting-period- and vaccination-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Meningococcal risk depends on age, immunity, carriage, close contact, living setting, strain and response timing.
Meningococcal evidence is person-, strain-, contact-, setting- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level disease probability.
Norovirus risk depends on setting, crowding, surface contamination, hygiene, symptom timing and vulnerable occupants.
Norovirus evidence is outbreak-, setting-, contact-, hygiene- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Bathing-water risk depends on microbial results, recent pollution, weather, catchment conditions, signage and exposure.
Bathing-water evidence is site-, sample-, season-, pollution-event- and user-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Algal-bloom risk depends on species, toxin production, location, weather, water use, exposure and sampling time.
Algal-bloom evidence is waterbody-, bloom-, sample-, exposure- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health probability.
Recall significance depends on hazard severity, exposure, affected population, units supplied, traceability and remedy effectiveness.
Product-notification evidence is report-, product-, market-, exposure- and corrective-action-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
